content.value: Consider, two strings “CSE" and “KUET”. Design a user define function “Catenation (char \*, (12) char \*)" having two parameters of character type pointer and only task of that function is to catenate one string after another. For example, Catenation (“CSE", “KUET") produce “CSEKUET”.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2019
